# CoralSwarm

> Organizational memory — automated. For humans and AI.

CoralSwarm captures what your team already produces, turns it into topics
you confirm, and answers questions — with citations — for people and agents
alike.

## How it works — three moves

Connect once. It captures, splits and groups — you confirm.

### 01 · connect

It starts with what you already have. Meetings, chat, email, code, agents.
They connect once and the swarm takes it from there — you never file
anything, and nothing is ingested that you didn't connect.

### 02 · corals

One source becomes six corals. A meeting doesn't file as one note.
Extraction splits it into atoms — decisions, people, threads, references —
each keeping its provenance to the second. Everything proposed this way is
for your review — you confirm. Nothing arrives on its own.

### 03 · reefs

Corals group into reefs. Related corals pull together into topics — you
confirm what forms. The reef and the logo are the same object.

## Ask + cite

Every answer cites its source. Ask in plain language. The answer stands on
the corals it cites — and when two sources disagree, it says so instead of
quietly picking one.

And it stays in its ocean:

- **Private first.** Every capture lands in your ocean and stays there.
- **You promote.** The team ocean gets exactly what you moved — nothing else.
- **Then the org.** Same gesture, same guarantee: nothing moves on its own.

## Agents · MCP

Agents forget. The reef doesn't. An agent's context dies with its session.
Plug it into the reef over MCP and every session opens already knowing what
your team knows. Same answer, same citations — whoever's asking.

- **Persistent context** — sessions end; the reef doesn't. No re-priming, no context docs pasted into prompts.
- **Team context, not chat history** — it answers from what the team knows: decisions, threads, references, not one user's transcripts.
- **Cited and scoped** — every answer carries citations; a token scoped to one ocean bounds what the agent can see.

## Pricing — one meter: the answer

14-day free trial at launch. Capture, ingestion and review are never
metered. One thing is counted: a query — asked by you in the app or pulled
by an agent over MCP.

### Personal Pro — $25/month

1,500 queries/month. Your own private ocean, every connector, MCP access
for your agents. Top-ups when you run dry, and a ceiling you set yourself.

### Personal Max — $100/month

7,000 queries/month. Everything in Pro at agent volume — for people whose
agents ask more than they do. Same trial, top-ups and self-set ceiling.

### Enterprise — talk to sales

Per seat, quota set with you. Team and org oceans on top of everyone's
private one — promote flows, review queue, scoped MCP tokens, admin limits.

## Private by construction (security)

- Nothing leaves your ocean until you promote it.
- Your keys never touch our servers — we can't read it, or recover it.
- On Enterprise, each tenant runs on its own private database, not a
  shared one.

## FAQ

### What is CoralSwarm?

CoralSwarm captures the work your team is already doing — meetings, chat,
email, coding sessions — and turns it into organizational memory,
automatically. It splits what comes in into atoms, groups them into topics
you confirm, and answers questions with citations, for people and AI agents
alike.

### How is CoralSwarm different from Notion or Obsidian?

Notion and Obsidian are places you write things down — the knowledge only
exists if someone takes the time to file it there. CoralSwarm connects to
what your team already uses and captures automatically, so nothing depends
on someone remembering to write a doc, and nothing is ingested that you
didn't connect.

### Do I have to write anything for knowledge to get captured?

No. Meetings, chat, email, code and agent sessions connect once, and the
swarm takes it from there — you never file anything yourself.

### Can AI agents like Claude use CoralSwarm?

Yes — CoralSwarm has an MCP connector, so an agent's session can open
already knowing what your team knows instead of starting from zero every
time. Answers are cited and scoped: a token bound to one ocean limits what
any agent can see, and it gets the same answer with the same citations a
person asking would.

### Is my data private and secure?

Yes. Every capture lands in your own private ocean and stays there until
you actively promote it — nothing moves on its own. Your keys never touch
our servers, so we can't read your data or recover it, and on Enterprise
each tenant runs on its own private database rather than a shared one.

### How much does CoralSwarm cost?

Personal Pro is $25/month for 1,500 queries; Personal Max is $100/month for
7,000 queries — both include every connector and MCP access, with a 14-day
free trial at launch. Enterprise is priced per seat and quoted with your
team; capture, ingestion and review are never metered, only queries are.
